scope: Original code roles composed using this language glossary. Modern proposals, not historically attested compounds. No related-language fallback or opaque collision suffix.
naming_principles: Vietnamese head-first technical noun groups and verb-first actions. Whole-role corrections take precedence over constituent composition. Preserve word boundaries with camel case and all Vietnamese tone marks. Standard project, protocol and processor names retain their identities.

rationale.기억공간: Vùng nhớ denotes an addressable memory region; avoid a literal recollection-space calque.
rationale.핵심: Nhân denotes the central operating-system kernel; use the technical inner-core metaphor.
rationale.체계호출: Lời gọi hệ thống names the service-call interface rather than a telephone call.
rationale.파일보존: Lưu giữ tệp describes preserving file contents across storage operations.
rationale.한국어: This API namespace belongs to the Vietnamese edition; Hangul character fixtures retain their original characters.
rationale.x86: The processor family is one proper technical name, not a coordinate and an unrelated number.
